name: HarmonicMotionEngine
description: This engine implements the harmonic oscillation of bodies. See also HarmonicForceEngine that applies a harmonic force, see also the `dynamics of harmonic motion <http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Simple_harmonic_motion#Dynamics_of_simple_harmonic_motion>`__

attributes.name: fi
attributes.description: Initial phase [radians]. By default, the body oscillates around initial position.
